description: Salon Versace operates both full-service and self-service dog bathing options at their Virginia Beach location on Lynnhaven Drive, with full-service pricing ranging from $35–$70 depending on dog size and coat type. They offer grooming, de-shedding treatments, nail services, and teeth brushing, operating Tuesday through Saturday from 8 AM to 6 PM, with appointments preferred though walk-ins accepted between 10 AM and 2 PM. The facility requires current rabies and distemper/parvo vaccinations and maintains strict safety protocols including leash control and supervision of children.
